qa_flags.question: Analyst (Julio Romero) asked whether the pool of partners/customers the company works with has increased, or whether growth is from doing more with existing customers.
qa_flags.response_pattern: First response from management addressed a different topic (Comfort Systems subsidiary companies collaborating/sharing workforce with each other), not the customer pool; the analyst had to explicitly rephrase ('I'm sorry to rephrase my question...') before getting a direct answer about customer concentration/repeat business preference.

qa_flags.question: And do you have a forecast for 2026 CapEx, Bill?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Declined to give a specific figure ('I really don't'), then hedged with a baseline percentage-of-revenue estimate instead of a dollar guidance number.

qa_flags.question: Did the two go hand in hand? Anything else that you would say is driving that operating leverage is it ultimately reflecting this benefit of the fixed overhead at modular this quarter?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Gave a general answer about execution and pricing, then explicitly said 'I don't know, maybe I didn't answer your first question' — self-acknowledged non-answer to the specific modular-vs-SG&A attribution question.

qa_flags.question: Analyst asked for the geography and core end markets of the pending electrical acquisition.
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO declined to give specifics, saying he 'can't get too specific' until the deal is announced because the target company's own people don't yet know.

qa_flags.question: Does generative AI becoming more mainstream and used by a broader array of applications create any kind of inflection or more customers seeking out Comfort Systems' services?
qa_flags.response_pattern: Trent does not confirm or deny an inflection; he says demand is already so high he 'wouldn't have noticed' if there was an increase, then pivots to a broader point about announced data center builds exceeding what is feasible, without ever directly answering whether GenAI mainstreaming itself changed inbound demand.

qa_flags.question: 新增產能有多少是給既有客戶、多少是給潛在新客戶、多少還待定（TBD）？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層先答「全部都是既有承諾」，接著針對上一季提過的「新客戶試用」用語做修正/淡化，兩度重複強調「這不是為新超大規模客戶做的試用」，語氣偏向收回先前措辭而非直接量化 TBD 部分。

qa_flags.question: 買下原本用租的廠房，是否也能為公司帶來財務彈性（資產價值、擔保品、選擇性）？
qa_flags.response_pattern: 管理層未正面回應資產價值/擔保品/選擇性這幾個具體詞，改談「營運端信任、優化團隊做法」，且回答句子中途未完（原文以刪節號結束），未直接對應分析師提問的財務彈性框架。
